fieldValues.title: How does a repository say how it should be seen, and what do packages offer?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised 2026-10-30 when the owner chose to open repositories on the Read view by default as an experiment (srs-web#673), and added: a human must have a view that makes sense; a generic repository may never be readable for everyone, but a person should get a sense of what is inside; a repository should probably be able to specify a default way to be seen; packages will define what editors and renderers are available. Today srs-web decides alone: Read when the repository has an identity record and a navigation section, else the explorer. Packages already offer editors through srs-web's registry (by entry type UUID), but nothing in the data says which view a repository prefers.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Nothing in the data: clients decide from structure (today's rule), and each viewer can override it. Cheapest; a repository author cannot steer it.
- B. The repository names its default view: a manifest or root-container entry naming a Composition, an editor id or a built-in view. Needs a spec change and a vocabulary of view names that every client can resolve.
- C. The package decides: a package declares the editors and renderers it provides and which is the default for a repository whose entry type it owns; the repository chooses only by which packages it installs.
- D. Both: packages offer views, and the repository picks one of the offered ones as its default (B constrained by C).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether the default-Read experiment makes these repositories easier to read for a newcomer (to be seen in use). Whether a repository's default view is data (spec) or a client setting. How a view a package defines is named so that srs-web, srs-vscode and an agent all resolve it the same way (capability layering: the core resolves, clients present). How it relates to the front door (RFC-013 OQ-1) and to Lenses' reserved pkg: lens ids. What a repository with no structure should show so a person still gets a sense of what is inside it.
